name: Graveyard of Shadows
accessNote: The Graveyard of Shadows sits in Wilderness levels 18-21 on the site of the former Zarosian fortress of Carrallanger; wandering zombies (levels 18 and 24) roam it. Reach it by running north from Ferox Enclave or via the Carrallanger (Ancient Magicks) teleport. Single-combat but cannonable and safespottable per the Slayer task/Zombies location table (pageid 298268). This is a PvP zone; bring Wilderness-appropriate risk gear.
